change.title: ao-replay/9095-r2
change.description: fix(agents): list nested Claude commands and dedupe plugins by resolved name
change.author: ronish

findings.title: Symlinked commands folder is no longer scanned (regression from os.ReadDir)
findings.body: The commands branch now uses `filepath.WalkDir(dir, ...)`. WalkDir starts with `os.Lstat(root)` and does not follow symlinks, so a symlinked root is not recognised as a directory. The callback sees a non-dir entry whose name does not end in `.md`, and no commands are returned. The old code used `os.ReadDir(root.dir)`, which follows a symlinked root. A `~/.claude/commands` or `<workspace>/.claude/commands` that is a symlink (common with dotfile managers) used to list its commands. After this change it lists none, with no error. The skills branch still follows symlinks: it uses `os.Stat` on each entry at lines 252-254. So skills and commands now behave differently for symlinks. Fix: resolve the root first, e.g. `if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(dir); err == nil { dir = resolved }`, before walking. Add a test with a symlinked commands directory.

findings.title: Nested-command test leaves out cases the new walker handles
findings.body:
`TestScanSkillsNamesNestedCommandsAndSkillFolders` covers only one level of nesting and a non-prefixed root. It does not cover the new `commandFiles` behaviours:
- hidden subfolders are skipped (line 304)
- plugin-prefixed nested commands, e.g. `plugin:ns:cmd`
- a symlinked commands root

The last is the case that currently regresses. Adding these would lock in the intended behaviour.

contracts.action: Scan Claude commands folders recursively with filepath.WalkDir and name nested commands by path (ns:cmd)
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous os.ReadDir loop over the root's direct entries (same function, removed lines), and the skills branch at skill_scan.go:241-285
contracts.before_after: Before: ReadDir followed a symlinked root and listed only top-level .md files. After: WalkDir does not follow symlinks (Lstat on root), so a symlinked root yields nothing. Nested files now appear as ns:name. Skills still use os.Stat on entries, which follows symlinks.
contracts.visible_effect: The chat `/` menu lists nested commands. A symlinked commands root now shows no commands.
contracts.failure_mode: WalkDir errors are swallowed (`return nil`), so unreadable paths are skipped silently. The menu is simply missing entries, and nothing is logged.

contracts.action: Deduplicate enabled Claude plugins by resolved manifest name instead of install-key name
contracts.equivalent_path: Same function, previous double seen-check (key name, then resolved name)
contracts.before_after: Before: a key whose name was already seen was skipped, and a resolved-name duplicate broke out of the loop. After: only the resolved name is checked. A duplicate appends nothing, and the loop still breaks after the first matching install.
contracts.visible_effect: Plugins whose manifest name equals another key's name are no longer dropped. The new test covers this.
contracts.failure_mode: None found. Keys are iterated in sorted order, so the result is deterministic.

summary: The plugin dedupe fix looks correct, and its test exercises the old failure. One regression: the new `filepath.WalkDir` commands scan returns nothing when the commands root is a symlink, whereas `os.ReadDir` followed it. That silently drops a user's commands from the `/` menu. I also suggest a few extra test cases.
